'use strict';
function errors(iterator: object) {
  const value = iterator as { locked?: number; read?: number };
  Object.defineProperty(value, 'locked', { value: 1 });
  Object.defineProperty(value, 'read', { get() { return 1; } });
  for (const operation of [
    () => { value.locked = 2; },
    () => { delete value.locked; },
    () => { value.read = 2; },
  ]) {
    try {
      operation();
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof Error) console.log(error.message);
    }
  }
}
errors([1].values());
errors(Object.setPrototypeOf([1].values(), null));
errors(Object.setPrototypeOf(new Map<string, number>().keys(), {}));
errors(Object.setPrototypeOf(new Set<number>().values(), null));
errors(Iterator.from({ next() { return { done: true, value: undefined }; } }));
